Name: Auaké
Remark: Auaké list, pp. 308–313; Koch-Grünberg 1928 (vol. IV, Sprachen), recorded by Theodor Koch-Grünberg during his 1911–1913 expedition (northern Brazil / Venezuela); his phonetic notation (Anthropos alphabet), not IPA. Auaké = Awake dialect of Arutani (Glottolog awak1251, under arut1244)

Name: Kaliána
Remark: Kaliána list, pp. 313–317; Koch-Grünberg 1928 (vol. IV, Sprachen), recorded by Theodor Koch-Grünberg during his 1911–1913 expedition (northern Brazil / Venezuela); his phonetic notation (Anthropos alphabet), not IPA. Kaliána = Sapé

Name: Máku
Remark: Máku list, pp. 317–324; Koch-Grünberg 1928 (vol. IV, Sprachen), recorded by Theodor Koch-Grünberg during his 1911–1913 expedition (northern Brazil / Venezuela); his phonetic notation (Anthropos alphabet), not IPA. Máku of the Uraricoera/Auari (isolate, ISO xak), not the Nadahup/Puinavean "Makú"
